headline: Ruslan Guseynov jumps from 1880th to 50th on ARC-2

sections.text: Ruslan Guseynov gained 15.55 to 43.33 on the ARC-AGI-2 public board, moving from 1880th to 50th.
The score sits well below the ARC-2 gold line of 66.53 at 16th. Public standings are provisional.
